about: A help desk agent receives a Wi-Fi problem and hands it to a network expert, who finishes it. Both run on Anthropic.
how: Each agent answers with JSON: finish with an answer, or hand over to another agent with a note. Here there is one handover.
learns: A handoff passes control with a note; the agent who gets it decides what to do next.
watch: The note of the help desk, and what the network expert does with it.
